explication: 3proxy is a configurable, multi-protocol proxy server. An administrator supplies configuration and a client connects to a configured listener; the server handles the selected proxy protocol and relays traffic, with optional authentication, DNS, TLS, access controls, and plugins. The README documents the broad capabilities, while sampled source confirms several internal mechanisms. Some protocol modules are indexed but unsampled, so their internal call relationships are not inferred.
